sentences.text:
The P.I., of K.R.Puram Police Station, Bengaluru, has filed the present charge sheet against the accused No.1 to 6 for C.C.No.54923/2018 the offence punishable under sections Secs.498A, 504,
506 R/ w Sec.34 of IPC and Secs.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
2.
BRIEF FACTS OF THE PROSECUTION CASE ARE AS UNDER :

It is the case of the complainant that, CW.1 got married to accused No.1 on 26.04.2004 at 'Vinayaka Hall', KGF as per Hindu tradition infront of elders and well wishers and at the time of marriage accused No.1 took one 16 grams gold chain, 18 grams three rings, clothes, shoes and 24 grams gold necklace, 15 grams gold ornaments for CW.1 and also took furniture as dowry.
After the marriage CW-1 has led marital life at her matrimonial house.

Subsequently, accused No.1 to 6 in furtherance of common intention have forced CW.1 to take Rs.1,00,000/- from her parental house as dowry as the accused No.1 intend to start the business, by that time, the parents of CW.1 i.e., CW.4 and 5 gave One Lakh to the accused No.1 as dowry.

It is further alleged that, after some days again, accused No.1 to 6 forced CW.1 to take dowry and abused her in filthy language, subjected CW.1 to cruelty by harassing both by physically and mentally to bring one Lakh dowry from her parental house and also threatened her with dire consequences.

Based on the typed complaint lodged by C.W.1, C.C.No.54923/2018 CW.10 has registered the case against accused No.1 to 6 in P.S. Crime No.303/2015 for the offence punishable under sections 498A,
354(B), 504, 506 R/w 34 of IPC and sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Investigating Officers/ CW.10 and 11 investigated the matter, after completion of the investigation, CW.11 has submitted final report against the accused No.1 to 6 for the above said offences.
3. Upon receipt of charge sheet, cognizance was taken for the above mentioned offences alleged against the accused No.1 to 6 and registered the criminal case against them.
4. After registration of the case, the accused No.1, 3 to 6 have appeared before this court and enlarged on bail as they were obtained anticipatory bail from the Hon'ble Sessions Court.
During the course of trial, accused No.2 and 3 were reported to be dead.
Hence, case against accused No.2 and 3 stood abated.
Copies of the final report and its' enclosures were furnished to accused No.1, 4 to 6 in compliance of section 207 of Cr.P.C.
Sufficient grounds were made out to frame charges.

Hence,
charges framed and read over to the accused No.1, 4 to 6.
They pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.

sentences.text: In order to prove the guilt of the accused No.1, 4 to 6, the prosecution has examined one witness out of 11 witnesses cited in the charge sheet as P.W.1 and relied upon documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.6 and closed its side.
In lieu of absence of incriminating circumstances appearing against accused No.1, 4 to 6, recording of their statement under section 313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
6. Heard both sides.
Perused the materials on record.

7. The points that arise for my consideration are;
1. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that the accused No.1 was married with CW.1 on 26.04.2004 and thereafter, the accused No.1 to 6 with a common intention have subjected CW.1 to cruelty by harassing her both by physically and mentally for more dowry and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.498A R/ w Sec.34 of IPC ?

2. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused No.1 to 6 in furtherance of common intention have abused C.C.No.54923/2018 CW.1 in filthy language and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.504 R/w 34 of IPC ?

3. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused No.1 to 6 in furtherance of common intention have threatened CW.1 with dire consequences and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.506 R/w 34 of IPC ?

4. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused No.1 to 6 have demanded One Lakh dowry from the parents of CW.1 and have subjected her to cruelty both by physically and mentally and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act ?
5. What Order?

8. My findings on the above points are as under:
 Point Nos.1 to 4 : In the Negative.
 Point No.5 : As per the final order  for the following;
 C.C.No.54923/2018  REASONS  9. POINT Nos.1 to 4 :-
As these four points are interlinked, I have taken up these points together for common discussion to avoid repeti- tion of facts & evidence.

4
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1, 4 to 6, the prosecution has examined the complainant/victim/C.W.1 as P.W.1 and relied upon six documents.

10. In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1, 4 to 6, the prosecution has examined the complainant / victim CW.1 as PW.1, wherein, the said witness has not supported the case of the prosecution.

The learned APP appearing for the State with permission treated the said witness as hostile and fully cross examined her, wherein, nothing was elicited from the mouth of the PW.1 in order to prove the guilt of the accused No.1, 4 to 6.
11.
On perusal of the materials on record and the oral & documentary evidence of P.W.1, she has categorically admitted that, she has compromised the matter with the accused Nos.1, 4 to 6.

In view of the evidence of P.W.1, since C.C.No.54923/2018 the matter was compromised, the prayer of the learned Senior Asst. Public Prosecutor for issuance of witness summons to other witnesses was rejected as no purpose would be served.

As the P.W.1 has turned hostile to the case of the prosecution, the evidence on record is not at all helpful to substantiate the guilt of the accused Nos.1,
4 to 6.
Hence, there is no cogent and convincing evidence against the accused Nos.1, 4 to 6.
Accordingly, the benefit of doubt has to be extended to the accused Nos.1, 4 to 6 and hence, the Point Nos.1 to 4 are answered in the "Negative".
12. Point No.5

: - In view of the findings on above points, I proceed to pass the following;
ORDER Acting under section 248(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused Nos.1, 4 to 6 are acquitted of the offence punishable under Secs.498A, 504, 506 R/w Sec.34 of IPC and Secs.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
The Bail bonds and surety bonds of the accused persons shall be in force for the period of 6 months and C.C.No.54923/2018 thereafter it shall be cancelled without further orders.
